title: Florida approves $20.15m easement protecting 219-acre ranch from development
description: A 219-acre cattle ranch in Florida received protection through a $20.15 million conservation agreement. This easement is part of a broader initiative preserving over 4,500 acres of agricultural land. The agreement ensures that the ranch can remain operational while preventing future development. It reflects efforts to balance agricultural needs with urban expansion pressures in the state. Protecting this land is vital for maintaining both wildlife habitats and agricultural sustainability.

title: New Jersey's 2019 dam removal brings eels and shad back upstream, study finds
description: Columbia Dam in New Jersey was removed in 2019 to allow the natural migration of fish. Recent studies show encouraging signs of recovery in fish populations, including American eels and adult American shad. Researchers monitored the river for nine years to assess the ecological impact of the dam's removal. The dam's removal also resulted in measurable improvements in water quality, including changes in temperature and dissolved oxygen levels.

title: Mumbai airport switches to manual processing after network glitch, flight ops unaffected
description: On Tuesday evening, Mumbai airport experienced a network disruption that lasted for approximately one hour. As a result, airport teams had to switch to manual processing for check-in and boarding. This manual processing aimed to minimize inconvenience to passengers during the disruption. Mumbai International Airport Ltd confirmed that flight operations remained unaffected throughout this period. The cause of the network issue was not disclosed by airport officials.

title: 13-goal blitz! India show no mercy as Mandeep runs riot at ACT hockey tournament
description: India began their Asian Champions Trophy title defence with a crushing 13-0 victory over Bangladesh. Mandeep Singh scored a hat-trick, while Harmanpreet Singh, Dilpreet Singh and Hardik Singh netted twice each. India dominated from start to finish, leading 6-0 at half-time. The defending champions will next face China on Thursday, while Bangladesh prepare to take on Malaysia.

title: India exported over $850m worth of arms to Europe since start of Ukraine-Russia war
description: Amid the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict, India's defence sector is witnessing an impressive surge in ammunition exports to Europe. With military demands on the rise, India has emerged as a key supplier, achieving record export levels. This growth highlights not only India's manufacturing strengths but also its expanding international partnerships. European countries are eager to restock their military supplies, which bodes well for the future of India's defence industry.

title: 'I apologize to everyone': Mbappé reacts to 'Chinese dictator' controversy

Beverage maker Dongpeng, dairy giant Mengniu and cheese producer Milkground ended their partnerships with the French footballer. China's Foreign Ministry criticised the remarks, while social media platform RedNote removed promotional material. Online criticism intensified, with boycott-related hashtags trending on Weibo.

title: Badoni joins Kohli, Gambhir in elite list with back-to-back double tons
description: In a remarkable display of skill, Ayush Badoni secured his second consecutive double century, remaining unbeaten at 210 in the Ranji Trophy against Jharkhand. Following his earlier 217 against Gujarat, he, along with Sumit Mathur, created a formidable partnership of 334 runs. With Delhi declaring at 515, they hold a significant advantage, while Jharkhand struggles on Day 2, finishing at 131 for four amidst a daunting deficit.

title: MIT students turn lunar waste into tools, win $925,000 in NASA competition
description: MIT students have pioneered a revolutionary recycling solution aimed at mitigating waste buildup on the Moon. As new supplies begin to arrive, it is vital to have efficient methods for dealing with packaging waste. This ambitious project, which has garnered accolades from NASA, seeks to transform waste into useful materials for lunar bases, setting a precedent for potential sustainability improvements both on the Moon and Earth.

title: Georgia man gets 15 years for $76m Ponzi scheme targeting 300 investors
description: Edwin Brant Frost IV, a businessman from Georgia, has received a 15-year prison sentence following his involvement in a Ponzi scheme that deceived more than 300 investors. This fraudulent operation caused a staggering loss of $76 million. Presenting himself as a reliable lender, Frost was actually battling significant financial turmoil. He misappropriated investors' money for his lavish lifestyle and political donations while neglecting loan repayments.

title: DJ Moore’s $5M mansion: Inside the 10,000-square-foot home listed after trade
description: DJ Moore’s North Carolina mansion remains unsold after several adjustments to its asking price. The Buffalo Bills wide receiver listed the waterfront property after being traded from the Chicago Bears to the Bills. The Charlotte estate boasts three levels of living space with several amenities like swimming pool, theater, gym, private balcony, and screened-in porch.

title: US midterms: Is Trump about to lose control of Congress? What betting markets say
description: Ahead of the November 3 US midterms, betting markets suggest Trump's Republicans could lose control of Congress, with Democrats favoured to win the House and Senate. The odds also point to a difficult contest for Vivek Ramaswamy in Ohio.

title: California court upholds order to remove 19 trees after $78,500 settlement
description: In a protracted legal battle between neighboring homeowners in California, the Fourth District Court has decided that the invasive roots of 19 ficus trees must be completely removed. Although a prior financial settlement provided some relief, the roots continued to cause damage, prompting the affected homeowner to seek a more lasting remedy. The court ruled that total removal of the trees was essential to eliminate the persistent nuisance.

title: 'It was just me and Sooryavanshi': Abhishek after his record-breaking innings
description: Abhishek Sharma credited preparation and a clear game plan for his stunning 113 off 38 balls against New Zealand, saying he had “manifested” the innings. His partnership with Vaibhav Sooryavanshi produced a record 118-run powerplay, powering India to a six-wicket victory. Mentor Yuvraj Singh playfully challenged him to break his 12-ball T20I fifty record, while praising Abhishek’s explosive performance.

title: Elon Musk’s six-word reply to Verizon CEO who said SpaceX needs 8 years to take it on
description: Verizon CEO Dan Schulman says SpaceX would need up to $500 billion, 80,000 cell towers and as long as eight years to build a US mobile network that rivals Verizon. Elon Musk hit back on X, saying it "will take 2 or 3 years". SpaceX plans to switch on Starlink Mobile in early 2028 after buying low-band mobile spectrum worth about $8 billion this month.

Abhishek smashed 113 off 38 balls, while 15-year-old Sooryavanshi made 45 off 18. Their 133-run stand powered India to a six-wicket win and an unassailable 3-0 series lead.

Speculation abounds regarding a possible alliance with the Congress, creating formidable challenges, especially given the BJP's strong ties with Chandrababu Naidu.

description: Dustin Moskovitz co-founded Facebook and later started Asana, where he served as CEO for over a decade. Despite his achievements, he admitted that managing teams was not his true calling. Moskovitz faced increasing challenges during his tenure due to external social and political upheaval. Many corporate leaders, like Moskovitz, find themselves in management roles without formal training or desire. This phenomenon of the 'accidental manager' has become common in workplaces.

title: Kelces’ Garage Beer sales surge 252% as major rival looms
description: Jason and Travis Kelce’s Garage Beer has emerged as a rising player in the US beer market, recording 252% sales growth in 2023 before the brothers invested in 2024. With 95 calories per serving and distribution across all 50 states, the brand is targeting mainstream light beer drinkers. Garage Beer expects to reach 300,000 barrels, but competing with established giants such as Michelob Ultra remains a significant challenge as it seeks long-term growth.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ KC Current set attendance record with 18,000 fans
description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' KC Current made history by welcoming a record crowd for their final home match of the 2026 season. Around 18,000 fans were expected, including 6,000 at Current Landing, where a $10 Ground Pass offered outdoor viewing, food and entertainment. The club also celebrated two new dining options and plans to host more events, expanding its reach beyond CPKC Stadium and strengthening its connection with Kansas City.
